title: Token swatches
description: The semantic tokens of one foundation, each drawn as its own value. Drawn by the TokenSwatches composite at the top of a Foundations page.

tokens.description: Every token of the foundation that has a drawing, in the scheme's order.

token.description: The token's full name, such as color.neutral.0. The composite draws it through its CSS variable.

type.description: The token's DTCG type, which with its name sets how it is drawn.

px.description: For a line height or a control size: its size in pixels, which the page prints beside it.
